name: The Waking Room
intro: The ceiling. Familiar in a way you can't place. The door is across the room.
outro: The handle is cold. Behind you the bed is already making its case.

nodes.label: Open your eyes
nodes.text: You are awake, and horizontal, and those are two different problems.

nodes.label: The First Rep
nodes.text: One repetition. Not a workout. Not a plan. One.

nodes.label: A Set
nodes.text: Well. You're on the floor anyway.

nodes.label: Again
nodes.text: The second set is the one nobody sees you do.

nodes.label: Something New
nodes.text: A different shape. Just once, to see.

nodes.label: One More
nodes.text: You know exactly what this costs now. That is the whole point.

nodes.label: The Door
nodes.text: Out. The hallway is cold and enormously ordinary.
